entries.quote: Then type in the amount you wish to have added with a negative sign (-) in front of it. Then process the transaction normally.

entries.title: Charge a sale to a store account
steps: Ring the items.
Attach the customer's withdrawal account to the receipt.
Press Total and then the credit account button.
entries.quote: Select Total on the point of sale and Press “credit account”
entries.note: Requires the account and its button to be set up in the back office first.

entries.title: Boca ticket printer: wait before loading tickets
steps: After powering on, wait at least 5 seconds before loading ticket stock.
The cutter moves rapidly at start-up and can jam tickets loaded too early.
entries.quote: When powering up your Boca, it is important to wait at least 5 seconds before loading any ticket stock.

entries.title: Boca prints in the wrong place or feeds blank tickets
steps: The sensors usually need cleaning; follow Boca's cleaning guidelines.
entries.quote: If your Boca is printing the ticket in the wrong place or printing blank tickets before or after the printed ticket, it often means the sensors on the ticket printer must be cleaned.

entries.title: Boca is skipping tickets
steps: Turn the Boca off.
Hold the test button and turn it on, keeping the button held for at least 5 seconds.
entries.quote: turn the Boca off, hold the test button, and then turn the Boca on while holding the test button for at least 5 seconds

entries.title: Boca tickets print with blank spaces
steps: The thermal printhead usually needs cleaning.
entries.quote: If tickets are printed with blank spaces, it usually means that the thermal printhead needs to be cleaned.

entries.title: Boca tickets are not cut properly or cut in erratic places
steps: Check the cutter is not blocked and moves freely.
Check the ticket stock is not defective, for example unevenly spaced or faint black marks.
entries.quote: If the tickets are not being cut properly, please ensure the cutter isn’t blocked and can move freely.

entries.title: Boca ticket printer care
steps: Clean it whenever dust is visible, and check each time ticket stock is changed.
Clean the platen at least once a year.
Do not store tickets in the printer out of season, especially adhesive stock.
Keep it on the connection configuration KORONA Support set up.
entries.quote: Additionally, we recommend cleaning the platen of the Boca at least once a year, regardless of ticket stock.

entries.title: Cancel and refund an event ticket order
steps: In KORONA Studio go to Sales > Orders, filter, and search the order number including the 'OR'.
Press Cancel at the bottom right and confirm with Cancel Order; the customer is emailed and the tickets become invalid.
Press Initiate Payment to refund.
Depending on the payment service the refund is immediate or needs a further step with the payment provider.
entries.quote: You will now need to refund the customer by pressing ‘Initiate Payment’:

entries.title: Change an item's price at the register
steps: Add the product to the receipt.
Key the new price on the number pad.
Press Change Item Price.
It works if the product is Price Changeable or the cashier has the Price permission.
entries.quote: Using the number pad, specify the price you want your product to be and select the Change Item Price button.

entries.title: Register asks for a price when an item is rung
steps: The item is an open product: it has no price in the back office and is price changeable.
Enter the price and press Enter.
entries.quote: KORONA POS will prompt you to provide a price for the product. Once you have entered the desired price, hit Enter, and the product will be added to the receipt.

entries.title: Receipt logo prints as a black box
steps: The image size or format is usually wrong.
Use the .png format, or change the image's size or dimensions, and upload it again.
Restart the POS.
entries.quote: If your receipt logo is showing up as a black box, that usually means its size or format is incorrect.

entries.title: Add a logo to the receipt
steps: In KORONA Studio go to Settings > Receipt Layout.
Click the box with the camera for the Header or Footer logo.
Click the plus button to upload the image.
Cancel the current receipt for the new logo to apply; if the logo got bigger, restart the POS.
entries.quote: You can cancel the current receipt for the new logo to apply, but if the size of the logo is increasing, you must restart the POS.

entries.title: Clock in or out at the register
steps: Press the Time Tracking button; a new screen opens.
Enter the cashier number (it can be different from the login code).
Press the action, for example Start Shift or End Shift.
entries.quote: Before performing the actual time tracking action, the cashier number must be entered.  Please keep in mind that the cashier number can be different from the login code.

entries.title: Fix a missed or wrong clock-in
steps: In KORONA Studio open the cashier's edit screen.
Under More > Time Tracking Entries, review, correct or create entries.
entries.quote: Time Tracking Entries can be reviewed, corrected, and created if missed in the cashier edit screen under More > Time Tracking Entries.

entries.title: Time tracking is only in the Retail package
steps: Time Tracking is only available in Korona's Retail Package.
entries.quote: Time Tracking is only available in our Retail Package.

entries.title: How price-embedded (deli/scale) barcodes are read
steps: The barcode is split as: leading digit, item number, price, check digit.
Example 2123450015955: 2, item 12345, price 001595 ($15.95), check digit 5.
Korona recognises in-store codes with 4, 5 or 6 digit prices, and 5-digit weight codes.
entries.quote: The barcode is always divided according to the following scheme: [leading digit] [item number / in-store code] [price] [check digit]

entries.title: Set up price-embedded barcodes
steps: In KORONA Studio go to Settings > Number Ranges, click Add Number Range and choose 'Add Sale' as the function.
Choose one Expression Type (4, 5 or 6 digit price, or 5-digit weight); only one can be active at a time.
On each product enter the matching product code and mark it Price Changeable.
Retrieve Master Data at the register and restart the software (restart is only needed after adding the number range).
entries.quote: Note: you can only have one of these options active at a time.

entries.title: Scale or deli labels will not scan
steps: The check digit at the end of the code is needed when scanning these items.
Make sure the barcode scanner's check digit setting is enabled.
entries.quote: Please make sure that your barcode scanner settings for check digits are enabled.

entries.title: Lottery sales and payouts are accounts, not products
steps: A lottery purchase is recorded as a deposit; a payout as a withdrawal.
Press the Lottery Purchase or Lottery Payout button and enter the dollar amount.
These do not count in revenue totals.
Do not create products for lottery.
entries.quote: Important: Do not create products for lottery transactions. Products are revenue-generating and would distort your reports.

entries.title: Trigger Production only prints each item once
steps: Trigger Production runs all allowed production types for items not yet produced.
Pressing it again on the same receipt does not reprint items already produced.
Some production types need payment first and cannot be triggered manually.
entries.quote: Even if the function is performed multiple times for the same receipt, the POS will only run an item’s production types once.

entries.title: Refund a bottle deposit
steps: Ring up the main product and press Extract Deposit Items; the deposit becomes its own line, and the main product can then be removed.
Or activate deposit refund mode and ring the product; a negative deposit line appears for the returned bottle.
The current mode is shown only next to the cashier's name.
entries.quote: To use them, activate deposit mode and then ring up the product again. A negative 15-cent line appears on the receipt for the returned bottle.
